article.title: “Sub-agent” defined.
article.content: A “sub-agent” is a person employed by, and acting under the control of, the original agent in the business of the agency.
article.html:
191“Sub-agent” defined.

Section 191 · Chapter X · Sub-Agents · page 44 of the Act

A “sub-agent” is a person employed by, and acting under the control of, the original agent in the business of the agency.
